facts.summary: FDA advised against BLA submission; 50% layoffs · Phase 3 · Cylembio in advanced melanoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The FDA has recommended that IO Biotech not submit a BLA based on the data from the IOB-013 clinical trial.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: treatment with Cylembio plus pembrolizumab improved progression free survival (PFS), however the results narrowly missed statistical significance.
evidence.program_discontinued: The company plans to continue the dialogue with FDA to align on the design of a potential new registrational study for Cylembio.
